_doc: Drive 9 whole-character round 3 finish: an overlay deep-merged over r2_finish.json (which is itself over d9_finish.json; d9_post.load_finish, lists replaced whole). Each change answers a round-2 blind critic (review/rosace/art/drive9/round-2/verdicts/); the reasons are in 'why'. The 'r3' block switches on round 3's steps in drive9/r3_post.py; without it d9_post.py runs exactly as round 2.

why.noise_blur: Critic materials 14/16 (round 2): 'cloth, bust and hair carry speckle noise that reads as dither grit, not painted texture; replace per-pixel noise with 2-3 px directional texture clusters'. The noise passes are box-blurred at the render scale (brush 1.4 px, strands 0.4 x 1.6 px) with their spread restored, then a despeckle pass (min cluster 2).
why.rim: Critic 17: 'a strong dashed cyan line inset 1 px from the outline: a double outline that flattens; merge it into the outline, continuous, lit side only'. The inset rim is off; the rim is drawn on the outline pixel of curved forms facing the rim direction, bridged, runs of 3 or more.
why.values: Critic 15: 'whites too bright and saturation high' (ours p90 luma 208, mean S 0.31 against ref G 186 / 0.20). White and veil top out at #e3dfe5; OKLab chroma x0.75 on white, dark cloth and haft, x0.85 on skin, hair and gold (the hues stay, PX-P39).
why.stocking: Critic 13: 'boots and thigh-highs are the same navy so the leg is one tube'. The stocking's lit side lets a muted rose through (sheer, refs E/G); the boot gets its own deeper, bluer ramp with a stronger gloss.
why.haft: Critics 7/16: 'the shaft stair-steps with alternating light/dark pixels; clean it to a straight 2-tone line'. The haft takes no texture or cavity and 5 tones.
why.hair: Critic 4: 'a banded purple helmet with a horizontal sheen stripe; a 5-6 tone hue-shifted ramp; a sheen arc that follows the skull; fringe clumps with dark gaps; flyaways; tapered azure tips'. The spec-band patch is off (sheen null, spec_k 0.25); r3_post draws the arc from the crown's own top edge, cuts the fringe, tapers the tips and adds 4 flyaways at 144 (2 at 80). 8 hair tones.
why.face: Critic 2/3: 'flat pale peach skin with no cheek or jaw form; restore the blush; relight the back-view face'. The head's cast shadow on the neck, a jaw step, a 2 px blush under each eye's outer half, and the face lift per shot (back 0.56: a fill on the turned face).
why.bust: Critic 5: 'two grey-lavender spheres in shadow, not one lifted form in the bodice; keep the bodice lit near-white; one designed highlight'. The cleavage wedge shrinks to the top 45 % (the neckline V), the underside step to 0.3, the key-facing bust is lifted toward the white ramp's 0.8 tone, one 4 px highlight on the lit apex.
why.belly: Critic 12: 'shade the lower belly into the tabard'. Skin beside the tabard takes a 2 px occlusion falloff.
why.fx: Critics 11 and first impression: 'no stretch, no smear; the refs sell the hit with FX'. MOVESET 0.6 puts N1's contact (f9) in the leaded stage: a crescent behind the blade tip about the front fist with A0 leading into cells and a G1 sliver. Q5's contact is 'butt strikes the floor; local flash; crack'. Drawn on the background only, left out of the silhouette and colour counts.
